shortDescription: Module for setup of TechSupport Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: case_number
options.description: Customer case number for which this techsupport is generated. Useful for connected portal and other use-cases. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: User provided description to capture additional details and context regarding the techsupport invocation. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: duration
options.description: Total time taken for techsupport collection. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: end_time
options.description: End timestamp of techsupport collection. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: errors
options.description: Error logged during techsupport collection. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: level
options.description: Name of the techsupport level. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of techsupport invocation. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: node
options.description: Cluster member node on which the techsupport tarball bundle is saved. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: obj_name
options.description: Object name if one exists. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: obj_state
options.description: State of current/last techsupport invocation. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: obj_uuid
options.description: Techsupport collection object uuid specified for different objects such as se/vs/pool etc. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: output
options.description: Techsupport collection output file path. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: params
options.description: Techsupport params associated with latest techsupport collection. User passed params will have more preference. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: progress
options.description: Techsupport collection progress which holds value between 0-100. Allowed values are 0-100. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Unit is percent. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: size
options.description: Size of collected techsupport tarball. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Unit is mb. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: start_time
options.description: Start timestamp of techsupport collection. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tasks
options.description: Events performed for techsupport collection. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tasks_completed
options.description: Completed set of tasks in the techsupport collection. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: techsupport_readiness
options.description: Techsupport readiness checks execution details. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: Tenant uuid associated with the techsupport. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: total_tasks
options.description: Total number of tasks in the techsupport collection. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid identifier for the techsupport invocation. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: warnings
options.description: Warning logged during techsupport collection. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.
